description: Quest Steps: - Give a total of 2 Weltcaps to [Gorf](https://mapgenie.io/mortal-shell-ii/maps/fallgrim?locationIds=939257), and rest at the beacon after each one to receive [Marsh Pearl 1](https://mapgenie.io/mortal-shell-ii/maps/fallgrim?locationIds=939261) and [Marsh Pearl 2](https://mapgenie.io/mortal-shell-ii/maps/fallgrim?locationIds=939275) - Give a total of 2 Common Moonshines to [Gorf](https://mapgenie.io/mortal-shell-ii/maps/fallgrim?locationIds=939257) and rest at the beacon after each one to receive [Marsh Pearl 3](https://mapgenie.io/mortal-shell-ii/maps/fallgrim?locationIds=939378) and [Marsh Pearl - Gorf 4](https://mapgenie.io/mortal-shell-ii/maps/fallgrim?locationIds=939379) - After resting at the beacon, remove the [Poisoned Dagger](https://mapgenie.io/mortal-shell-ii/maps/fallgrim?locationIds=939380) from Gorf - Hand over Poisoned Dagger to [Hilga](https://mapgenie.io/mortal-shell-ii/maps/fallgrim?locationIds=939381) and rest at any beacon - Return to [Hilga](https://mapgenie.io/mortal-shell-ii/maps/fallgrim?locationIds=939381) and read the Note, rest at the beacon - Return to [Gorf](https://mapgenie.io/mortal-shell-ii/maps/fallgrim?locationIds=939257) and give him another Common Moonshine and rest at the beacon once more - Return to [Gorf](https://mapgenie.io/mortal-shell-ii/maps/fallgrim?locationIds=939257) to get yet another [Marsh Pearl - Gorf 5](https://mapgenie.io/mortal-shell-ii/maps/fallgrim?locationIds=939447) and rest at the beacon - Rest at the beacons a couple more times until Daots appear!
